WITH before_region AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        AVG(sales) as avg_sales
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE week_number BETWEEN 13 AND 24
    GROUP BY region
),
after_region AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        AVG(sales) as avg_sales
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE week_number BETWEEN 26 AND 36
    GROUP BY region
),
region_pct_change AS (
    SELECT 
        r.region,
        (a.avg_sales - r.avg_sales) / NULLIF(r.avg_sales, 0) * 100 as pct_change
    FROM before_region r
    INNER JOIN after_region a ON r.region = a.region
),
before_platform AS (
    SELECT 
        platform,
        AVG(sales) as avg_sales
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE week_number BETWEEN 13 AND 24
    GROUP BY platform
),
after_platform AS (
    SELECT 
        platform,
        AVG(sales) as avg_sales
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE week_number BETWEEN 26 AND 36
    GROUP BY platform
),
platform_pct_change AS (
    SELECT 
        p.platform,
        (a.avg_sales - p.avg_sales) / NULLIF(p.avg_sales, 0) * 100 as pct_change
    FROM before_platform p
    INNER JOIN after_platform a ON p.platform = a.platform
),
before_age_band AS (
    SELECT 
        age_band,
        AVG(sales) as avg_sales
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE week_number BETWEEN 13 AND 24
    GROUP BY age_band
),
after_age_band AS (
    SELECT 
        age_band,
        AVG(sales) as avg_sales
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE week_number BETWEEN 26 AND 36
    GROUP BY age_band
),
age_band_pct_change AS (
    SELECT 
        ab.age_band,
        (a.avg_sales - ab.avg_sales) / NULLIF(ab.avg_sales, 0) * 100 as pct_change
    FROM before_age_band ab
    INNER JOIN after_age_band a ON ab.age_band = a.age_band
),
before_demographic AS (
    SELECT 
        demographic,
        AVG(sales) as avg_sales
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE week_number BETWEEN 13 AND 24
    GROUP BY demographic
),
after_demographic AS (
    SELECT 
        demographic,
        AVG(sales) as avg_sales
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE week_number BETWEEN 26 AND 36
    GROUP BY demographic
),
demographic_pct_change AS (
    SELECT 
        d.demographic,
        (a.avg_sales - d.avg_sales) / NULLIF(d.avg_sales, 0) * 100 as pct_change
    FROM before_demographic d
    INNER JOIN after_demographic a ON d.demographic = a.demographic
),
before_customer_type AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_type,
        AVG(sales) as avg_sales
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE week_number BETWEEN 13 AND 24
    GROUP BY customer_type
),
after_customer_type AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_type,
        AVG(sales) as avg_sales
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE week_number BETWEEN 26 AND 36
    GROUP BY customer_type
),
customer_type_pct_change AS (
    SELECT 
        ct.customer_type,
        (a.avg_sales - ct.avg_sales) / NULLIF(ct.avg_sales, 0) * 100 as pct_change
    FROM before_customer_type ct
    INNER JOIN after_customer_type a ON ct.customer_type = a.customer_type
),
results AS (
    SELECT 'region' as attr_type, AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct_change FROM region_pct_change
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'platform', AVG(pct_change) FROM platform_pct_change
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'age_band', AVG(pct_change) FROM age_band_pct_change
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'demographic', AVG(pct_change) FROM demographic_pct_change
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'customer_type', AVG(pct_change) FROM customer_type_pct_change
)
SELECT * FROM results ORDER BY avg_pct_change

WITH before_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type,
        AVG(sales) as avg_sales
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE week_number BETWEEN 13 AND 24
    GROUP BY region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type
),
after_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type,
        AVG(sales) as avg_sales
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE week_number BETWEEN 26 AND 36
    GROUP BY region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        b.region, b.platform, b.age_band, b.demographic, b.customer_type,
        b.avg_sales as avg_sales_before,
        a.avg_sales as avg_sales_after
    FROM before_sales b
    LEFT JOIN after_sales a ON b.region = a.region AND b.platform = a.platform 
        AND b.age_band = a.age_band AND b.demographic = a.demographic AND b.customer_type = a.customer_type
)
SELECT 
    region, avg_sales_before, avg_sales_after,
    (avg_sales_after - avg_sales_before) / NULLIF(avg_sales_before, 0) * 100 as pct_change
FROM combined
WHERE avg_sales_after IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY pct_change
